title: Remove browser access to eight out-of-band Space backup and staging tables

source.ref: Metadata-only Supabase catalog review, Frequency Community, 2026-10-27

detail: Live metadata review found eight public out-of-band backup/staging tables with RLS disabled and effective anon/authenticated table privileges. Column names include private Space preferences, website-editor state, entitlements, historical site content and notes. No rows were selected and no API access was attempted. A permission-only operator transaction now targets these exact tables plus the two previously reviewed SEC-002 backups; it enables RLS, removes table and per-column browser rights, preserves service/operator access, and fails closed when targets are missing or postconditions fail. Do not delete or move backup data under this row. Production repair and post-repair catalog verification remain outstanding; no SQL was applied by the implementation lane.

verify.evidence: OPEN: Metadata-only catalog review confirmed the exposure on 2026-10-27; the repair SQL has not been run. After separately authorized execution of scripts/ops/secure-frequency-backups.sql against the documented Frequency Community project, inspect pg_class.relrowsecurity and effective has_table_privilege/has_any_column_privilege for anon/authenticated on all ten exact allowlisted tables; verify service_role/operator access is preserved and run the live-catalog check/security advisors. Do not select backup rows. Keep open until live postconditions are confirmed.
